correctness.rationale: Invertibility of the structure matrix forces automorphisms to be monomial, solving the diagonal and swapped polynomial equations exhaustively. Matrices with 3 nonzero entries are rigid; all-4-nonzero swapped locus satisfies a³c=bd³ and t²≠1, yielding (q−1)²(q−1−h); diagonal two-support gives s C2; antidiagonal support produces C2 for gcd(3,q−1)=1 and C3 or S3 counts 2s/3,s/3 when gcd=3. This proves exact 1/C2/C3/S3 distribution, probability (q+1−h)/(q(q+1)), h=gcd(2,q−1), and simple conditional probability (q−h)/(q²−q+1) from bc≠0. Independent exhaustive GL2(F_p) checked p=2,3,5,7, including C3,S3 at 7. A finite list is not the all-field proof; support stratification is.
residual_risks: Scope depends on uniform labelled matrices and q prime power; not isomorphism-class uniform, geometric automorphisms or general dimension.
